resolution: illustrates.rule set to 16.5.1.h per standards-map.md's own BANA §16/B004 §11 worked-examples table (the project's established canonical id), not either run's own guess. print.blocks/print.notes follow Run B's schema ([ref:MARK] tokens inline + a separate print.notes[] array of {ref, placement, text}), matching this task's required schema; Run A instead folded each note's real content directly into a sibling print.blocks entry with no [ref:MARK] markers and always an empty print.notes[] -- a schema-level difference, not a content disagreement. braille.width: verified directly: line 12550, stripped of its 7-space left padding, is exactly 40 characters, right-justified to the braille page-number token '#afe'. braille.lines: the two runs agreed byte-for-byte; kept as transcribed.
